Quick context and asks:

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Addendum request — pilot capacity + pricing hold

Vivek / Steph — thanks for the context. I reviewed Ellipsis' draft and attached a tracked redline (rwi_counter_redlines.docx). Summary of our approach and recommended edits below.

Summary of redline (high level):
- Capacity: Accept +5 reserved GPU slots for a fixed three-month pilot term (2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31) provided Ellipsis executes the addendum and issues a PO within 10 business days of countersignature. We add a provision limiting rollover; unused capacity does not automatically extend beyond term.
- Pricing hold: We will agree to a temporary pricing hold limited to the specific reserved-sku unit price for the pilot term only. No retroactive discounts or credits. Add explicit effective dates and a sentence that published ratecard changes after 2026-12-31 will apply thereafter.
- Exhibit E (SOW): Add acceptance checklist with concrete success metrics (ingestion rate, schema match rate, data sampling pass). Limit acceptance window to 14 calendar days with one 7-day remediation window. Include a sign-off step by both parties' technical leads.
- Liability / SLA: Do not grant SLA exceptions for temporary capacity; instead include a limited liability carveout for pilot window tied to best-effort burst capacity. This reduces exposure if we must shift traffic to other pools.
- Termination / rollback: Add a clause allowing Redwood to suspend capacity if usage materially exceeds the agreed cap or if excessive preemption is needed for higher-tier commitments. Provide 48-hour notice where possible.

Commercial concessions / ask-backs:
- Require PO + Ellipsis signature (procurement + Head of Ops) rather than PO-only.
- Add a short clause: Ellipsis to provide a contact for capacity escalation and to attend a 30-minute runbook session prior to Oct 1.

I note one open legal point: their draft includes a single-sentence reference to data retention that is ambiguous. I'll propose a short data-retention appendix or refer to our standard DPA.

I'll circulate the tracked doc to you both. If that looks ok, I'll convert to a PDF and send to Ellipsis with a short cover note.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

- Exhibit E (SOW): Added an acceptance checklist (14-day acceptance window + one 7-day remediation). Sign-off by both technical leads required for acceptance.
- Operational caveats: We added a limited liability carveout for pilot capacity and a 48-hour notice right if we need to suspend capacity to meet higher-tier commitments.
